name: Vilankulo Airport
before:
The airport for Vilankulo, in Mozambique's Inhambane Province.

It was substantially rebuilt at the start of the 2010s. A nine million dollar programme refurbished, expanded and modernised the airport, and the new air conditioned terminal was opened in April 2011 by President Armando Guebuza.

The work did two things that matter when planning an itinerary. It lifted capacity from 75,000 passengers a year to 200,000, and it made it possible for larger aircraft to use the airport at all.
after: The airport for Vilankulo, in Inhambane Province, Mozambique. Its present terminal was opened by President Armando Guebuza in April 2011.
